lines.name: The Book of Love
lines.about: A side quest for the Temple of Mara in Riften: Dinya Balu sends you to help people in love, first Fastred in Ivarstead, then Calcelmo in Markarth, then a pair of long-dead lovers. A mod adds a second quest, The Book of Love - Fastred's Choice, that lets Fastred leave her suitors and travel Skyrim with you.

getIn.where: the Temple of Mara in Riften; around noon to 3 pm she may be at the Riften market
getIn.how: Talk to Dinya Balu and agree to help the temple; she sends you first to Fastred in Ivarstead.

order.what: You match Fastred of Fellstar Farm with Bassianus or Klimmek, carry a poem bought from Yngvar the Singer from Calcelmo to Faleen and bring her letter back, then put on the Amulet of Mara and bring Fenrig to Ruki, returning to Dinya Balu after each.
order.where: Ivarstead, Markarth and the Temple of Mara in Riften

order.quest: The Book of Love - Fastred's Choice
order.what: Instead of choosing a suitor, Fastred comes travelling with you once her parents agree, and on returning to Ivarstead she decides whether to leave home for good or stay.
order.where: Fellstar Farm and Klimmek's House in Ivarstead, the road across Skyrim, and the Temple of Mara in Riften
order.needs: Offered by Fastred during her part of The Book of Love.

options: Suggest Fastred travel with you instead, which starts The Book of Love - Fastred's Choice.

branches.at: The Book of Love - Fastred's Choice
options: Return Fastred's feelings, or turn her down; either way you head back to Ivarstead.
Fastred leaves Ivarstead: she tells her parents and both suitors, and Dinya Balu gives you both Mara's blessing if you are together.
Fastred stays in Ivarstead: you help her settle things by speaking to one of her suitors.

gives: Agent of Mara (perk), from Dinya Balu at the end of The Book of Love
Fastred as a travelling companion, in Fastred's Choice
Mara's blessing from Dinya Balu, if Fastred leaves Ivarstead with you as a couple
closes: If Fastred leaves Ivarstead for good, Bassianus goes to Riften alone and Klimmek stays in Ivarstead
While Fastred's Choice runs, one line of The Book of Love's dialogue is switched off

unsure.why: No level gate shows in the records (no start conditions, starts with the game), so the level the line is made for isn't given.

Fastred's opening line for Fastred's Choice has no condition text in the extracts, so the exact point in The Book of Love when she offers it isn't confirmed. Where the ghosts Fenrig and Ruki are isn't in the files.
Agent of Mara comes from the quest script, not a confirmed hand-over. What Mara's blessing gives, whether Fastred stays as a permanent follower, and whether you keep the Amulet of Mara aren't stated.
Whether the suitor Fastred doesn't pick in The Book of Love is closed off isn't recorded; neither read lists an effect on him, so it is left out of closes.

lines.name: Seeking A Cure
lines.about: Two quests for a vampire looking for a cure: Urag gro-Shub at the College of Winterhold points you to Falion in Morthal, and a mod's follow-up letter from Falion sets you making a potion with Phinis Gestor at the College. It needs you to be a vampire; the records give no level gate.

getIn.how: As a vampire, ask Urag about a cure and read 'Undeath Undone'; a note from Falion falls out and Urag sends you to Falion at Falion's House in Morthal.

order.what: Falion prepares for three days, you bring him a filled Black Soul Gem, and you stand in his circle at dawn while he performs a ritual that fails.
order.where: the Arcanaeum, Falion's House in Morthal and the ritual site

order.what: A letter from Falion tells you how to make daedric essence; you make it, bring it to Phinis Gestor, wait for him to contact you and create a potion to remove vampirism.
order.where: the Arcanaeum or the Bards College, the Aetherium Forge and the College of Winterhold
order.needs: Seeking A Cure ended with the failed ritual.

options: Bring your own filled Black Soul Gem, or ask about the one Falion keeps.
Drink the potion you made, or not; the quest ends asking 'Should I drink it?'

gives: A potion to remove vampirism, which you make at the end of A Forlorn Hope
closes: Falion dies if you choose to kill him after the ritual

unsure.why: No level gate shows in the records; the vampirism check itself isn't readable in the extracts.

Rising at Dawn rewrites the opening and several of Falion's lines wait for an early hidden stage; what sets that stage, and where 'Undeath Undone' sits, aren't shown. You may also be able to go straight to Falion, who is rumoured to have studied vampires.

Where the dawn ritual takes place isn't in the extracts. What sends Falion's letter for A Forlorn Hope, and how it arrives, aren't shown. Using the Aetherium Forge may need the quest that opens it, but that isn't in these records.
Rising at Dawn adds a cure potion to Seeking A Cure, but the extracts don't show whether you can end up cured there.
Whether killing Falion blocks his letter and so A Forlorn Hope isn't shown.

lines.name: Undeath
lines.about: A Necromancer story from a mod: you track the Necromancer Antioch and his three followers from an ambushed Vigil of Stendarr caravan in the Reach to Scourg Barrow in the Dragontail Mountains, then can learn a ritual in Apocrypha that turns you into a Lich. Scourg Barrow's enemies run from level 30 to 80, and Antioch is level 80 in the records.

getIn.where: on your travels; it starts when you enter a new area
getIn.how: Your journal notes a rumor that a Vigil of Stendarr caravan was attacked on a road in the Reach; go looking for it.

order.quest: Black Book: Whispers of the Veil
order.what: You read the Black Book 'Whispers of the Veil' from deep in Scourg Barrow, which takes you to Apocrypha to learn the lost ritual to become a Lich.
order.needs: Find the Black Book in Scourg Barrow.

order.what: You construct the Phylactery, create the Elixir of Defilation, set up a Ritual Site and complete the Ritual of Transcendence.
order.where: Ravenscorn Spire or the Solitude Sewers
order.needs: Finish Black Book: Whispers of the Veil.

order.what: You find the ambushed caravan, read the Ambush Orders on a dead Necromancer and search Ravenscorn Spire for Antioch's journal.
order.where: a road in the Reach and Ravenscorn Spire

order.what: You stop Wynestra and her Necromancers digging up the grave of former Archmage Vyngald.
You clear Gundar and his Necromancers out of a Temple of Arkay and decide the fate of the captive priest.
You kill Selonius the Mad and his Necromancers at their cauldron and decide what to do with it.
order.where: the Ritual Site, a plateau overlooking the Reach

order.what: You search the bodies of Antioch's three followers, read the Orders, travel to the Dragontail Mountains and defeat Antioch in Scourg Barrow.
order.needs: Wynestra, Gundar and Selonius the Mad are all dead.

options: Re-cover Vyngald's grave and let him rest.
Take the Shroud of Vyngald from the coffin and defeat his apparition.
Free the captive Priest of Arkay.
Slaughter the priest and take the Priest of Arkay's Heart.
Try to complete the concoction for Namira's Corrosion or Embalming Essence; if it fails, the cauldron is spoiled.
Set up the Ritual Site at Ravenscorn Spire or in the Solitude Sewers.
Perform the ritual and become a Lich for good, or don't.

gives: Becoming a Lich, with Undeath (ability), Dark Resurgence (ability), Unbind Soul (spell) and Light Steps (perk)
A ritual chamber at Ravenscorn Spire or in the Solitude Sewers
closes: Your mortal life: becoming a Lich can't be undone, and in your true form people of Skyrim fear and hate you (Illusion magic lets you look mortal again)
If any part of the Lich ritual is missing or wrong, it fails and you are killed
Antioch, Wynestra, Gundar and Selonius the Mad die
The captive Priest of Arkay dies if you take his heart
A failed brew in Infernal Alchemy spoils the cauldron for good

unsure.why: The start is a change-location event whose conditions aren't decoded, so which place or level sets it off isn't known. The quest also uses the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth for something the records don't explain.

The line lists the two Lich quests first, but by their reads they come after Scourg Barrow. Ravenscorn Spire and Scourg Barrow have no hold in the places index; the Spire's door needs the 'Ravernscorn Spire Key' and who carries it isn't shown. The scripts that start the follow-up quests aren't in the files.

The Lich rewards are named from script properties, without effect text. The Phylactery and Elixir recipes aren't in the files; the earlier journals hint that the Heart, the elixirs and the Shroud matter for them. Which of the two elixirs Infernal Alchemy gives isn't shown. The Shroud's stats aren't known.

lines.name: The Tools of Kagrenac
lines.about: A mod quest line in which Mathis Valen sends you after the lost Tools of Kagrenac, taking you from Markarth to the College of Winterhold, Raven Rock on Solstheim, Ayleid ruins near the Cyrodiil border and Blackreach. The records give no level gate.

getIn.where: the note finds you; Mathis waits in the Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth
getIn.how: A courier hands you an anonymous note; read it and meet Mathis Valen at the Silver-Blood Inn, who tells you where the lost Tools of Kagrenac are.

order.what: You find Vonos Dreloth's missing ring and return it to him.
You can bring Wraithguard back to Yassour Tansumiran; both steps are optional.
order.where: The Retching Netch in Raven Rock, and Nchardak

order.what: You get Sunder and Wraithguard, find three Bal am as Aedra stones, go through a portal in Blackreach to Dwarven ruins, meet Mathis there, defeat him and his two bodyguards and restore the tools at an ancient pedestal.
order.where: Silver-Blood Inn in Markarth, College of Winterhold, Raven Rock, Nchardak, Ayleid ruins, Blackreach and the Silent Ruins

order.what: You lower two portcullises, find the key to the Main Chamber and defeat the Ayleid Lich.
You find the three Stanzas of Kagrenac, place them on the receptacles and disable the magical barrier.
order.needs: The cursed key from Vonos Dreloth.

gives: The Tools of Kagrenac restored to full power
closes: Mathis Valen and his two Sixth House bodyguards die in the final fight

unsure.why: Kagrenac's Tools starts when an item enters your inventory, and it holds the Keening dagger as a script property, so picking up Keening may be the trigger; the conditions aren't in the files.

The line lists Lost Heritage and My Precious first, but Kagrenac's Tools is the opening quest that sends you to Vonos and Yassour; their dialogue likely only opens then, but the line conditions aren't shown. Whether Lost Heritage's ring is what earns the cursed key isn't stated. Which ruin holds each Bal am as Aedra stone isn't certain.

The plugin has weakened and full-power Sunder, Wraithguard and Keening; exactly which items you end up holding isn't spelled out. Lost Heritage, My Precious, Darkest Depths and Vivec's Trial of Wisdom record no reward.
Mathis Valen is flagged essential in the records though the quest has you defeat him. Whether handing Wraithguard to Yassour costs you the gauntlet isn't shown.
